overview_description.description: Lio develops software tools that support teams in organizing operational data and managing business workflows through customizable digital registers. The platform provides a mobile and web application that allows users to create structured records for activities such as sales tracking, inventory monitoring, expense logging, customer management, and task coordination. It replaces paper registers and spreadsheets by offering configurable tables, forms, and templates that capture and store business information in a centralized system.
